Working all day with the nicest flowers as a warehouse employee? 🌸 Get a salary of €16,78 per hour and only work the morning shifts! Sounds good, right? It’s possible at Royal FloraHolland in Honselersdijk! 🥳

What we offer
- Starting salary of € 16,60 gross per hour
- Get a permanent contract quickly!
- Travel allowance or public transport subscription
- Get €0,18 extra allowance. You'll get €16,78 p/h💸
- Get paid weekly!
- Enjoy free flowers up to 5 times a year! 💐

Who you are
To make sure everything runs smoothly, it's important that as a warehouse employee, you'll meet the following requirements:

- You meet the 1.65m height requirement.
- You are available 1 to 5 days per week especially on Monday.
- You can start working at 05:45h and the ending time is between 09:30h and 12:00h.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You can work in Honselersdijk.

What will you do
Your workday at Royal Flora starts early in the morning. ☀️ As a warehouse employee you’ll start at 05:45h already! The time you finish depends on the workload of that day. Usually you finish work between 09:30h and 12:00h. Enough time to do other fun stuff then!

You handle orders filled with beautiful flowers and plants for the flower auction! 🌷You drive on a small vehicle all around the warehouse, orderpicking flowers. Order complete? Great, then you drive to the other department to hand them over. Grab a new empty cart and off you go again! We’ll teach you everything about operating this vehicle on your very first day. 🥳

Where will you work
You’ll work at Royal FloraHolland in a huge warehouse! It’s big, but it feels cozy as warehouse employee. You will know your way around in no time! At Royal Flora they love to see you grow, work long-term and achieve your best. They truly take the time to support you in this journey 🌱

And the best part? You’ll work in a friendly, fun team. Also you get to join in on exciting staff events! Before you know it, you’ll feel completely at home at Royal Flora
